hero.subtitle: O Meron é um client de e-mail mais calmo. Organize as suas mensagens num quadro kanban, leia-as como chats e personalize-o com temas bonitos.
hero.screenshotAlt: Meron kanban board turning emails into a draggable board
features.inbox.title: Email that reads like a conversation
features.inbox.body: Every thread becomes a calm, chat-style conversation. All your accounts flow into one place, so you can reply in the moment instead of wrestling with a cluttered mailbox.
features.gallery.title: Find every attachment, instantly
features.gallery.body: Photos, designs, and documents from a thread are collected into a visual gallery and grid. Browse, preview, and open the file you need without scrolling through endless replies.
themes.title: Make it feel like yours
themes.body: A rich palette of light and dark themes — from Indigo and Mist to Midnight and Forest — plus fully custom ones. The previews below follow your light or dark mode, just like the app.
openSource.title: Your mail stays yours
openSource.body: Meron is local-first: your messages stay on your device, not on our servers. The full source is released under the AGPL-3.0 license, so you can read it, audit it, and build on it.
openSource.screenshotAlt: Meron media grid alongside a conversation
download.title: Get Meron
download.subtitle: Free and open source. Pick your platform and grab the latest release.
